newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower, while the short end of the market staged a recovery following major declines in recent sessions.

Traders said activity was thin and quiet. The next key event is likely to be release of U.S. producer prices and U.S. retail sales on Friday. The figures, for March, are expected to show producer prices rising 0.1 percent in the core rate and retail sales, excluding autos, up 0.4 percent.
The short end of the market continued to improve after its earlier tumbles. Swiss National Bank economist Georg Rich speaks later this evening in New York.
As expected, the SNB left its discount rate unchanged at 1.00 percent after today's meeting. No change was expected in the rate.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 up 10 at 110.95
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 up six at 98.03.
